name: Lawrence Bremer
source:
A bachelor in age, who gave his youth to his business, but now is a simple owner of a multi-room house. From the memory of his niece, he was a wonderful uncle who loved her and all his relatives.

Now, there is only memories and a desire to help his niece, the daughter of his older sister.
A midlife crisis or traumatic events of the past have broken a person? Or an all-consuming passion for beer?
